sentence: Failed order syncs now retry with backoff and give up after five attempts, shop owners get a daily digest of the failures, and admins can retry a failed sync from the badge.

goals.title: Failed syncs retry automatically with backoff
goals.quote: A sync that fails is retried on its own, waiting longer each time.

goals.title: Syncs give up after five attempts and are marked failed
goals.quote: After five failed attempts the sync is marked failed and stops retrying.
stops: f3.h1@marks the sync failed on the fifth attempt

goals.title: Shop owners get a daily digest of failed syncs
goals.quote: Each morning the shop owner gets one email listing the syncs that failed in the last 24 hours.
goals.gap: No test covers the digest job, the mailer or the template.

goals.title: Admins can retry a failed sync from the UI
goals.quote: A failed sync shows a Retry button that queues it again.
goals.gap: Nothing tests the retry endpoint, its policy or the button.
